name: Repeated Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that repeated sin places a person in bondage, as Jesus declares that whoever commits sin is a servant to it, underscoring the seriousness of ongoing disobedience. Yet, the call to repentance remains central, with the promise of forgiveness and joy in heaven when a sinner turns back, as illustrated by the rejoicing over one repentant sinner. Believers are urged to lovingly confront sin and forgive those who repent, reflecting Christ's command to obey His commandments as an expression of love. The gospel call to repent and be baptized highlights the transformative power of turning from sin and receiving the Holy Spirit.
